survivingClaim: Lead 23 closes as an obstruction: in the window model with outside zeros fixed to zeta's, the real-node Pick LMI of order K <= 24 adds nothing to the explicit-formula LP. PROVED: Pick matrix linear in the zero measure, on-line pairs PSD, quartet = 2P_t + R, LMI is a function of the zero configuration only. GRID-CERTIFIED for the five tabulated node families at all 15 (T,K) cells (product 0.32 at (100,24), below 4e-6 for T >= 1000); CERTIFIED 445/445 LP-feasible points pass Pick and 40/40 LP duals pass on the grid. Corrections: for general node sets the Proposition D hypothesis fails at (100,24) (product up to 6.4) and the T >= 1000 bound is 1.1e-5 not 4e-6; at (100,24) the equality rests on the direct single-quartet criterion (critical multiplicity >= 61 vs cap 19.5 on 22 node sets, grid values), node-uniform statement OPEN. Thresholds are MEASURED and model-dependent. DH accepted at its true quartet; twisted prime sides give the same kind of exclusion sets. No statement about zeros of zeta. R1-R4 all false.
obstruction: The real-node Pick matrix is linear in the zero measure, on-line pairs add PSD terms, and the LMI never contains the primes; so the joint window SDP equals the explicit-formula LP (delta*_joint = delta*_EF, T in 1e2..1e6, K <= 24; grid-certified on five node families, node-uniform statement open at (100,24)). No exclusion for L <= L*/2 at any height. Untested: an LMI whose on-line terms are not sign-definite (sector matrices P+-B).
controlsThatDefeat: sign-twisted primes (same kind of exclusion sets)
lesson: A positivity LMI that is linear in the zero measure and monotone in on-line mass cannot couple to the explicit formula: it acts only where it already excludes the configuration with the window emptied (K of about 4 per zero below, i.e. the verified-height horizon), and it is blind to the prime data. Half-plane Pick kernels for Re z > a0 are implied by the support constraint. Weakest point: the domination constant is certified on a grid and on five node families plus 48 hill climbs, with only a factor 2.5 margin at (T,K) = (100,24).
followUp: none for lead 23. If the lane is revisited, the only untested variant is an LMI whose on-line terms are not sign-definite (the sector matrices P+-B of stack-feasibility section 6); they were not run here.
